task: Which kind of value should each one be?

options.text: Roll number: whole number, height: decimal, city: text
Roll number: whole number, height: whole number, city: text
options.why: A height like 1.33 has a decimal point, so it is a decimal.

options.text: Roll number: text, height: decimal, city: text
options.why: A roll number is counted and compared like a number, so it is stored as a whole number.
A city name is made of letters, so it is text.

payload.spec: A form stores a student's roll number (like 12), their height in metres (like 1.33) and their city (like Pune).

ok: Counts like a roll number are whole numbers, measurements with a point are decimals, and names are text.
